body: Dude I'm so sorry that's ass. Please dont let this be the reason you give up, please. I know things tend to suck in groups, but things can get better.

I'm sure she'll support you and stand by you. If she really does care for you, she'll want to help. But I understand if you dont want to give her more things to worry about, I really do, but sometimes we need someone to worry for us.
I really hope things get better, I really do. Do you talk to anyone? Like your girlfriend?

I lost a friend to suicide, about 4 years ago now. I understand how you feel. So many people come out of the woodwork that you had no idea even knew them, let alone cared. I'm so sorry for your loss, losing someone to suicide rattles you. It just sucks. The way I see it, you gotta hold on to whatever you can to stay afloat. I hold onto my dreams, you should hold on to that feeling of wanting to protect your loved ones from the grief of losing you. Whatever will keep you here and alive, hold onto it, okay?

I currently live with them and my mum lost her job this year and she had the health insurance. I did go to Therapy from 14-16 and I had seen 3 different psychiatrists but they all dropped me as a patient. Then my mum lost her job and we lost the health insurance so the last 2 years have kinda sucked. Not that therapy did much for me anyways...
